title: concurrent reservations stay within the daily cap

checks.name: every ledger line is complete JSON (no torn append)
the admitted total stays within the daily cap
the admitted total matches five units (no lost reserve)
no reservation was settled or released
no provider call happened (streams were abandoned before iteration)

notes: Twenty real OS processes contended on the same ledger file; the lock is taken before read-check-append, so the check is serialized with the write.
Each worker reserved exactly one unit (CNY 0.106) and never iterated the stream, so pending reservations drive the cap.
